caption: The drawing features a central scene framed by an ornate circular border of white leaves and floral patterns with green foliage and pink flowers at the four corners. Inside the central area, there are two human figures: one standing, wearing a long green coat and pink trousers with a pink top hat, and the other sitting atop a horse, dressed in a pink outfit with a matching hat. The horse is facing left and colored in pink with brown detailing. Behind them is a church-like building with a steeple, colored in shades of yellow and brown, surrounded by green bushes and trees. The ground is depicted in light pinks and greens, with clusters of pink rocks and green plants interspersed throughout. The background is a pale yellow, and additional trees with brownish trunks and green canopies are visible, contributing to the natural setting. The entire scene is symmetrical and enclosed within the decorative circular border on a cream-colored background.
title: Wallpaper from Bandbox Cover
